messages:
alex: FYI — we just had a weird warmup/prefill issue in eu-west-a. Prefill jobs pinned several dedicated slices to az-b where NIC tx queues spiked and that cascaded into a handful of evictions. Not a full outage but per-route tail latency jumped.
tanya: saw that. spikes show NIC transmit queue > 400ms for 30s. allocator logs show AZ affinity constraint blocked cross-az warmup even though capacity was free in az-c.
mike: my quick read — allocator honored hard affinity for 'warm_prefill=true' tenants. fallback policy only triggers on "no capacity" not on NIC saturation. we need a path for 'resource-degraded' fallback.
sara: careful — some tenants are regulatory-bound to az-a only. we can't just move warmup for ALL. Need a whitelist for cross-az warmup and a metrics-gated relax rule.
infra-bot: alert: eu-west-a prefill job 1822003454 -> NIC_QUEUE_HIGH on host gpu-47 (tx qlen 1920) — autoscale not triggered (policy: prefer_affinity).
mike: proposal: add a short-circuit to allocator that treats NIC saturation as "soft capacity shortage" for warmup routing. pseudo-config:

```
allocator:
  prefill:
    allow_cross_az_on_degraded_network: true
    degraded_network_threshold_ms: 200
    tenant_whitelist: ["sensitive-*", "gov-*"]
```

alex: +1 to gated relax. ops concern: if we start cross-az warmups aggressively we'll increase egress and cost. Need telemetry & a ruled approach (percent of prefill traffic, cost cap).
tanya: can we gate by tenant tier? e.g., non-enterprise free to cross-az warmup, enterprise opt-in. We'll add a metric that counts cross-az warmup bytes and alert when >5% of baseline.
mike: I'll draft a canary: enable allow_cross_az_on_degraded_network for dev tenants in eu-west, 10% traffic, 1h canary, monitor NIC_QUEUE and per-route P95.
sara: SGTM. I'll update rollout doc and whitelist patterns for gov/sensitive tenants. ops, please note potential cost bump.
alex: action items: mike -> canary PR + test plan; tanya -> add alert for cross-az warmup egress% and NIC_QUEUE; sara -> update whitelist and compliance note. Let's reconvene after canary (1h). :thumbsup:
